plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 57 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 97 (Alaska Hwy).
Park: 58.67002, -123.73282, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 23 km S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1,070 m, about 572 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 200 m W of the spot at 669 m (58.46117, -123.72694). Water: unnamed wetland 140 m SE (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-50, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-09-20, closures 2026-10-16.
